catalog.name: FormCel
catalog.summary: Spreadsheets on your own machine, with Excel files in and out.

notes_for_owner: UNTESTED: formcel had no build workflow, so no earlier run backs this entry. Its launcher has no 'desktop build'; the build is ./build_app (macOS, Linux) and build_app.bat (Windows). Not in formportal's products.json: the catalog entry is written from the README and tauri.conf.json (project file .fcel from the README). build_app puts the Rust build outside the checkout (~/.cache/formcel/tauri-target) unless FORMCEL_CARGO_TARGET is set, so the entry sets it to src-tauri/target to make the bundles findable; build_app.bat has no such override and builds in src-tauri/target. build_app builds only 'deb' on Linux by default; FORMCEL_BUNDLES=deb,appimage (the script's own variable; tauri.conf.json lists deb and appimage, no rpm) is set here and is a choice, not something a workflow did. On macOS build_app builds the .app and packs the dmg itself with hdiutil; it takes no --config, so there are no updater artifacts (the app has no updater plugin anyway). Windows runs build_app.bat, which needs python on PATH.
